name: What happens during the walk-through and inspection phases?

mainEntity.name: What happens during the walk-through and inspection phases?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before closing, there will typically be a walk-through with the builder to identify any unfinished items or defects, creating a 'punch list.' It's also advisable to arrange for an independent home inspection, even for new construction. A key process clarity point is that the inspection can uncover issues not apparent during the builder's walk-through, giving you leverage to request repairs before closing. Your real estate agent can help coordinate these critical steps to ensure the home meets quality standards.
acceptedAnswer.description: During walk-throughs and inspections, you identify defects and create a 'punch list' for the builder to address before closing.
